sloka: गगनाद्भूतले चाशु प्रतिगृह्यावतारितः ।वानरैः पीड्यमानस्तु शुको वचनमब्रवीत् ॥६-२०-१७॥।।
transliteration: gaganādbhūtale cāśu pratigṛhyāvatāritaḥ ।vānaraiḥ pīḍyamānastu śuko vacanamabravīt ॥6-20-17॥।।

translations.english: Being attacked by Vanaras, Suka told these words. "Oh Kakuthsa Rama messengers should not be killed. It will be good to prevent the Vanaras."
